name: Peanuts
hook: Schulz's neighborhood of misfits, one beagle and a football that never stays put.

facts.label: Charles Schulz
facts.statement: Charles Schulz created Peanuts in 1950 and drew it until 2000; his Santa Rosa museum recreates his studio and holds original strip art.

facts.label: Charlie Brown
facts.statement: Charlie Brown is the round-headed kid who finally hits a home run on March 30, 1993, and he is the 'Charlie Brown' of the rock song asking who walks in the classroom cool and slow.

facts.label: Snoopy
facts.statement: Snoopy is a beagle whose fantasies include Joe Cool, and the Red Baron is his nemesis in the comic strip.

facts.label: Woodstock
facts.statement: Woodstock is Snoopy's small yellow bird friend; he debuted as a Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade balloon in 1988.

facts.label: Linus
facts.statement: Linus is Lucy's blanket-toting younger brother, and he shares his name with the man who taught music to Hercules.

facts.label: Peppermint Patty
facts.statement: Peppermint Patty's full name is Patricia Reichardt.

facts.label: the Great Pumpkin
facts.statement: The Great Pumpkin is Linus's Halloween imaginary being; the 1966 TV special gave Charlie Brown the line 'I got a rock.'
